name: Menlo Insurance MCP
description: Lists Menlo property and casualty insurance products and quote links over MCP without auth, then continues one OAuth-authorized quote application and attaches supporting documents.

skills.name: Product Catalog
skills.description: Lists Menlo insurance products with labels, available states, and quote URLs via list_products and get_quote_link, no authentication required.

skills.name: Quote Application
skills.description: Starts and advances an insurance application through start_quote, get_current_page, and answer_quote_page, one page of questions at a time.

skills.name: Application Review
skills.description: Reviews a completed application with review_quote_application and sends it to the brokerage via submit_quote_request.

skills.name: Carrier Follow-Ups
skills.description: Tracks quote progress with get_quote_status and resolves underwriter questions through get_missing_questions and answer_additional_questions.

skills.name: Document Attachment
skills.description: Attaches supporting files to an in-progress quote with attach_quote_document and reads the linked profile via get_connected_quote_profile.
